title: The Ocean Meditation
description: In today’s brief yet powerful Soul Snack, Gary Zukav guides you through a deep relaxation meditation that helps you connect with the expansive, peaceful energy of the ocean.
As you allow your body to fully relax, Gary encourages you to imagine becoming one with the ocean , dissolving the boundaries between yourself and the water
This meditation invites you to explore the feeling of oneness and interconnectedness as you release separateness and embrace the peaceful flow of energy that connects everything.
By the end of this meditation, you’ll feel more grounded and open to future experiences of joy and connection.
Tune in to this soothing meditation to deepen your connection with the energy around you, and embrace that sense of oneness and tranquility.
